d:
Elio learns that a strange monster has appeared in a swamp in the forest near the town, so he takes on a request to investigate the area.

There, he encounters a witch named Dorothea, who is conducting research on clay golems. She asks Elio to cooperate with her research, and he agrees. However, right there on the spot, Elio is transformed into mud...

What fate awaits Elio?
n: [Doujinshi] [Nano Trans (Nano, Kuratsuka Riko)] Clay Golem Create [English] [MTL]
